about: Ronnie, who drives the tow truck, waiting on his paperwork outside the impound pen in the police yard (plans/yard.gd). Placeholder lines written on 2026-11-15 by the civic worker, not the owners' wording. Format: see scripts/talk_box.gd.

choices.say: What happened to the red one?

tow.speaker: npc
tow.line: Towed it, chained it, signed for it. Now I wait on the paperwork.

red.speaker: npc
red.line: Came in like that. Somebody got to the good parts before we did.

back.speaker: npc
back.line: Anybody with the fee and the papers. Most of them never come.
